audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 2 and 3 read Yorick while whys[1] says 'it stays skill-based' and whys[2] says 'it's still even'; level 6 read Skill while whys[4] says 'you tip ahead'.
audit.why: phases[N].side and win[N] are the same row and three of them disagreed with the sentence printed beside them. The packet reads Skill for levels 1-5 and Yorick from first item; the mirror also puts level 6 on Yorick.
audit.corrected: Rows 1 and 2 to Skill, row 4 to Yorick at 7/10, as matched full/content pairs.

audit.why: Level 6 into first item is the genuine flip — Maiden and ghouls absorb slams and out-DPS her.
audit.corrected: Kept; Test of Spirit's 16s at rank 1 and 900 range added so the central 'dodge it' advice carries a window.

audit.whatIsWrong: Harsh Lesson does not appear anywhere on the page, in any layer.
audit.why: It is the ability that actually delivers her damage: a 400-range leap onto you, an auto-attack reset, and it makes every nearby Tentacle swing at the target — on a 4-second cooldown. The page tells you to trade 'when her tentacles are down', but tentacles do not have the cooldown that matters; Harsh Lesson does.
audit.corrected: Named it with its cooldown and its tentacle-triggering effect, and recorded the auto-reset wind-up as the step-back cue rather than the cast.

audit.whatIsWrong: Executioner's Calling sits in report[8] boilerplate but no trading line says when the healing decides the trade.
audit.why: Prophet of an Elder God heals her whenever a Tentacle damages a champion, so her healing scales with the length of the fight.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds tied to extended trades in breakdown.mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing addresses whether Dark Procession interacts with her Tentacle spawns.
audit.why: Riot's text says Tentacles spawn on nearby impassible terrain, and Dark Procession creates terrain — but whether the game treats a summoned wall as a valid spawn surface is not stated anywhere I can verify.
audit.corrected: Left off the page deliberately and logged as unverified rather than guessed.

edits.before: Trade strictly around Test of Spirit: when it is down, run your full pattern; when it is up, give nothing. If ahead, freeze and starve him.
edits.after: Trade around Test of Spirit's 16s: when it is spent, run the full pattern. Her passive heals off every tentacle hit, so Grievous Wounds comes before long trades.

edits.before: That is Illaoi's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.

edits.before: The early lane is a careful skill matchup — it's a farm race where the only thing that matters is dodging Test of Spirit (E); eat no tentacle slams, use ghouls to soak them, and trade only when her tentacles are down.
edits.after: The early lane is a careful skill matchup — a farm race decided by dodging Test of Spirit (E) at 900 range. Harsh Lesson is her 4s leap and an auto reset, so the wind-up is your cue to step off, not the cast; soak the slams with ghouls.

edits.before: Never fight in her tentacle field — dodge Test of Spirit (E) at all costs, and use ghouls plus your wall to body-block her Tentacle slams while you trade only when tentacles are on cooldown.
edits.after: Never fight in her tentacle field — dodge Test of Spirit, 16s at rank 1 from 900 range — and remember Harsh Lesson is what drags the slams onto you, so its wind-up is the moment to step out, not the cast.

edits.before: Fight inside a dense tentacle field for max slam damage
edits.after: Harsh Lesson you inside a dense field so every tentacle swings
